items.quote: said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse
items.contrast: Micah’s mother, the person addressed as “you,” versus Micah, the speaker.
items.reason: Micah is speaking to his mother and says that he heard “you” utter the curse, so the key is fully supported. The question clearly tests who performed the action within the quoted speech.
